callouts.title: 欧拉关于素数导数和的定理

classification_result.english_title: Euler's Theorem on the Sum of Prime Reciprocals

if_problem.statement_en: Let $\mathbb{P}$ be the set of prime numbers. The series $$\sum_{p\in \mathbb{P}} \frac{1}{p}$$ diverges.
prerequisites: Euler product for the zeta function

callouts.title: 以上问题的定量版本问题
callouts.body: 假设$p\in \mathbb{P}$,估计由级数定义出来的函数$$S(x):=\sum_{p\leq x} \frac{1}{p}$$

classification_result.english_title: Quantitative Version of the Above Problem

if_problem.statement_en: Assume $p\in \mathbb{P}$. Estimate the function defined by the series $$S(x):=\sum_{p\leq x} \frac{1}{p}.$$

callouts.title: Mertens第二定理,1874
callouts.body: 存在一个常数$B$(现在称之为Mertens常数)使得$$\sum_{p\le x}\frac{1}{p}=\log\log(x)+B+O\left(\frac{1}{\log(x)}\right)$$

if_problem.statement_en: There exists a constant $B$ (now called the Mertens constant) such that $$\sum_{p\le x}\frac{1}{p}=\log\log(x)+B+O\left(\frac{1}{\log(x)}\right).$$

callouts.title: Euler发现的现象
callouts.body: 序列$nQ+1,n\in \mathbb{Z}^{+}$的素因子里的素因子不属于集合$\{p_1,...,p_N\}$

callouts.title: 同物异表
callouts.body: 用两种不同的途径表示同一个对象，从而导出新的关系。

classification_result.english_title: Different Expressions of the Same Object

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Different Expressions of the Same Object
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Represent the same mathematical object in two different ways and compare the resulting formulas. This often reveals a new identity, inequality, or structural relation.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Use this when an object admits multiple natural descriptions, such as algebraic, analytic, or combinatorial representations.
